shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Drag the grip to reorder. Edit the command to pass arguments or use an alias.
shortcuts.no_shortcuts: No shortcuts. Add one or pick a preset below.

appearance.ui_scale_desc: Drag, or use Ctrl + scroll wheel / Ctrl + + / Ctrl + − / Ctrl + 0.
appearance.layout_desc: Mobile stacks everything into full-width pages with a bottom bar and bigger touch targets. PC keeps the sidebar and side panels.
appearance.animations_desc: System follows the OS reduced-motion setting; On and Off override it.
appearance.language_desc: Choose the interface language. System will match your browser locale.

welcome.pick_folder: Pick a folder to create your first project.
welcome.click_shortcut: Click a shortcut above to launch a terminal.
welcome.tap_or_pick: Tap + to open a terminal, or pick one from Projects.
welcome.pick_thread: Pick a thread on the left to bring it to life.

sidebar.keep_awake_on: Keep-awake on — click to allow auto-sleep

git.not_repo_desc: This folder is not a git repository.
git.confirm_delete_msg: {path} is not tracked by git. Deleting it cannot be undone.
git.confirm_discard_msg: Working-tree changes to {path} will be lost. Staged changes are kept.

branch_dialog.description_part2: can either carry your current changes with you or stash them before switching.
branch_dialog.bring_changes_desc: Modified and staged files follow you to {branch}.
